races.name: Follow Us On Instagram At GuidenstownStud Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
NEW BOND STREET showed the benefit of her first run when finishing third at Naas 18 days ago and, with her yard going well, she could be ready to get off the mark. Snowing is feared most with Aidan O'Brien having landed this race 4 times in the last 6 years, with Tradewinds and Jewel In A Crowd completing the shortlist.

  1. NEW BOND STREET
  2. SNOWING (IRE)
  3. TRADEWINDS (IRE)

races.name: Grand Hotel Malahide Irish European Breeders Fund Fillies Juvenile Race
races.verdict:
IBELIEVEICANFLY proved a let down here last time but she was surrounded by next-time-out winners when second over C&D the time before so she's worth another chance with Ryan Moore keeping the faith. Her stablemate Speckles was a big eye-catcher in a C&D maiden 3 weeks ago so is respected, while Suomenlinna and Miss Hong Kong are a couple of interesting newcomers.

  1. IBELIEVEICANFLY (USA)
  2. SPECKLES (IRE)
  3. SUOMENLINNA (IRE)

races.name: Guidenstown Stud Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
SHAKESPEARE is the mount of Ryan Moore from the Ballydoyle trio and can make it third time lucky in a race in which his stable has saddled a future Group 1 winner in each of the last 3 years. Anchor Road shaped well when third over C&D last time and may provide the chief threat. Loughrea N Roll and the selection's stablemate Raging Bull are just a couple of many newcomers in the line-up who are bred to have good futures.

  1. SHAKESPEARE
  2. ANCHOR ROAD (IRE)
  3. LOUGHREA N ROLL (IRE)

races.name: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap
races.verdict:
HEADMASTER looked a sprinter on the up before a lesser effort here last time, and he's given another chance in a race that should be run to suit. Erosandpsyche and Rosie Frith head the dangers in a competitive renewal.

  1. HEADMASTER
  2. EROSANDPSYCHE (IRE)
  3. ROSIE FRITH (IRE)

races.name: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
BIG MOJO has been successful on his 2 previous attempts at Group 3 level and last year's Haydock Sprint Cup hero can resume winning ways with his sights lowered. James's Delight can turn around Greenlands form with Big Gossey and give his fellow British raider most to do.

  1. BIG MOJO (IRE)
  2. JAMES'S DELIGHT (IRE)
  3. BIG GOSSEY (IRE)

races.name: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
This doesn't look a vintage renewal so CELERON is taken to follow up his wide-margin win in the Railway Stakes over C&D. Sun Goddess is the other Group 2 winner in the line-up and she rates the obvious threat for a trainer who has won this a record 17 times.

  1. CELERON
  2. SUN GODDESS (IRE)
  3. FOLSOM BLUES (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
races.verdict:
LOHOOBB shaped with plenty of encouragement on recent stable debut and gets the vote to open his account. Mint Man has dropped to an appealing mark and heads the list of dangers from Hugo's Girl and Go Athletico.

  1. LOHOOBB
  2. MINT MAN
  3. HUGO'S GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap
races.verdict:
MARMELADOVA won in the manner of a well-handicapped horse at Leopardstown last time and can defy a 2 lb rise. Class-dropper Booyea and in-form Goal Exceeded are feared most, with Dark Viper and No More Porter also worth considering in a competitive finale.

  1. MARMELADOVA (IRE)
  2. BOOYEA (IRE)
  3. GOAL EXCEEDED

races.name: LOROS - Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AL WATHBA went down only to a smart prospect on his debut and this Group-entered colt should make no mistake here.

  1. AL WATHBA (FR)
  2. JIMTROTT (IRE)
  3. EBT'S WARRIOR (IRE)

races.name: Catalogue Engineering Nursery
races.verdict:
If GREEK SYMPHONY's trend for race-by-race improvement continues she should be able to cope with a 2 lb nudge for Lingfield. Love Rome could take another step forward now moving into his first handicap and is second choice ahead of Jazzy Bay.

  1. GREEK SYMPHONY
  2. LOVE ROME (IRE)
  3. JAZZY BAY (IRE)

races.name: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap
races.verdict:
BARAK WARRIOR showed much improved form when making a successful handicap debut at Bath last time, pulling clear with one who has landed a hat-trick since, and he can continue his progress to follow up. Mountbatten had excuses on his latest outing and is worth another chance, with Al Maslool also in the mix.

  1. BARAK WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. MOUNTBATTEN (GER)
  3. AL MASLOOL

races.name: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for TAMZAN, who arrives in good heart despite having not been seen to best effect at Beverley on her latest outing. Back down in trip, she gets the vote ahead of last-time-out winner Cancelled, while Venetian Sky is one to note as she goes handicapping for her leading yard.

  1. TAMZAN
  2. CANCELLED (IRE)
  3. VENETIAN SKY (FR)

races.name: ADS Handicap
races.verdict:
ART LOVER showed enough on return to suggest he can finally get his head in front in handicap company. Ray Mon Dough and Sea Cookie head the list of dangers in an interesting 3-y-o race.

  1. ART LOVER (IRE)
  2. RAY MON DOUGH
  3. SEA COOKIE (IRE)

races.name: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for PISANELLO to maintain his recent winning streak from what is still a handy mark. Course winners Ricardo Phillips and Clipsham Noble can lead the rest home in that order.

  1. PISANELLO (IRE)
  2. RICARDO PHILLIPS
  3. CLIPSHAM NOBLE (IRE)

races.name: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse 'Training Series' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Having finished runner-up off his much-reduced mark here last time, SUNDIATA KEITA may go one better in first-time blinkers. Macanudo, Macarone and Arnaz have also fallen a long way in the weights and need considering in a very tricky sprint.

  1. SUNDIATA KEITA (IRE)
  2. MACANUDO (IRE)
  3. MACARONE

races.name: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery
races.verdict:
The stands rail was the place to be when they raced here on Thursday, which should give DREAMLOVER the edge over Dreams Galore. Nursery debutant Chianti also needs considering.

  1. DREAMLOVER (IRE)
  2. DREAMS GALORE (IRE)
  3. CHIANTI

races.name: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations / EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes
races.verdict:
GLOBAL SUCCESS sets the standard on her latest fifth in a strong Goodwood nursery and may get off the mark with the aid of a handy draw. Romidijo and Eastern Queen appeal as likely dangers, with Bahia Bonita an interesting each-way contender.

  1. GLOBAL SUCCESS (IRE)
  2. ROMIDIJO
  3. EASTERN QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Floyds Turfcare Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
Consistency has been a bit of an issue for GO VICTOR so far but if he's in the same form as when successful at Pontefract a fortnight ago a 3 lb rise may not prevent him following up. 5f course scorer My Mate Mackley is second choice ahead of Rogue Rebellion.

  1. GO VICTOR (IRE)
  2. MY MATE MACKLEY
  3. ROGUE REBELLION

races.name: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
The thriving DESERT CHARM is taken to land a third win in her last 4 starts. Galactic Glow, Knightmare and Redhot Whisper head the many dangers in a competitive race for the grade.

  1. DESERT CHARM
  2. GALACTIC GLOW (IRE)
  3. KNIGHTMARE (IRE)

races.name: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap
races.verdict:
CRIMSON ROAD came good on his fourth outing for this yard over C&D last month and remains well treated on old form. Olly Murphy has an excellent record with handicap debutants so Dancingondiamonds may emerge as the biggest threat.

  1. CRIMSON ROAD (IRE)
  2. DANCINGONDIAMONDS (FR)
  3. SYMPHONY'S SONG

races.name: WTW Willis Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SHODA should open her hurdles account if somewhere near her best. Searcog and Lilannbee look most likely to fill the places.

  1. SHODA (IRE)
  2. SEARCOG (IRE)
  3. LILANNBEE

races.name: Randox Rated Hurdle
races.verdict:
There should be more to come from COSMOS D'AINAY, who can make it 2-2 for the season. Malbay Madness is narrowly preferred to Chanceawetmorning in the battle for silver.

  1. COSMOS D'AINAY (FR)
  2. MALBAY MADNESS (IRE)
  3. CHANCEAWETMORNING (IRE)

races.name: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
TROPICAL TWIST was much improved when winning at Wexford on Friday and looks capable of following up under a penalty. Gortmore Lady took a step back in the right direction over C&D last time and rates the chief danger, while Pralognan has an absence to overcome but is a previous course scorer and is respected with the Tony Martin yard back among the winners.

  1. TROPICAL TWIST (IRE)
  2. GORTMORE LADY (IRE)
  3. PRALOGNAN (FR)

races.name: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SAMBA TRAIN remains open to improvement and is taken to gain compensation for her mid-race exit at Galway, with her mark still looking fair. Theflyingbee and Cobra Queen head the lengthy list of dangers in a competitive handicap.

  1. SAMBA TRAIN (IRE)
  2. THEFLYINGBEE (IRE)
  3. COBRA QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
YOUNG DORAN made an encouraging start to his career when second at Ballinrobe in May and is taken to go one better now. Thesilverbridle also finished second on her debut and may provide the chief threat ahead of Magical Sal. Gordon Elliott's Lygon Lad needs monitoring in the betting back from an absence.

  1. YOUNG DORAN (IRE)
  2. THESILVERBRIDLE (IRE)
  3. MAGICAL SAL (IRE)

races.name: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
GEORGIA CELENA is a C&D winner who goes well here and ran up to her best when a neck second at Wexford 17 days ago, so looks worth siding with in a race where consistency should count for plenty. Speakasyoufind needs to bounce back from a below-par performance but remains of interest on his June runner-up effort, while the often well-backed Hay Baby is respected on just her second start for Emmet Mullins.

  1. GEORGIA CELENA (IRE)
  2. SPEAKASYOUFIND (IRE)
  3. HAY BABY (IRE)

races.name: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday Flat Race
races.verdict:
This looks a good chance for CULLDOO to build on her debut third here in the spring. Stuart Crawford's Loves A Laugh also started her career by finishing third in a course bumper and is second choice ahead of Martymill, who may find this easier than a big-field race at Galway last week.

  1. CULLDOO (FR)
  2. LOVES A LAUGH (IRE)
  3. MARTYMILL (IRE)
